feeds.title: Cuckoo4Design » Macrame
feeds.description: Read budget styling, and simple DIY macrame ideas on Cuckoo4Design. I'm a German citizen living in the US who is cuckoo for all things DIY, design, and pets. This is my design journey of our small home on a budget. Come stay a while and look around.

feeds.title: Mary Maker Studio Blog
feeds.description: Find guides for an easy step-by-step Macrame rainbow pattern, perfect for beginners. Also, tips on selecting macrame cotton and fiber supplies to create a unique look. Mary Maker Studio was founded by Artist Brydie Stewart, born out of her love for home interiors, rich textural mediums, and the belief that art can transform and enliven a space.

feeds.title: Tassel&Plume » Macrame

feeds.description: This section features articles on macrame. Jennifer Rogers, founder of MoonGazing Studio started as a way to fundraise for a local community wildlife rescue and educational center during the restricted COVID-19 lockdown. We are providing the highest quality cord, step-by-step instruction, and terrific service. We strive to be a Nature and Kindness Warrior every day!
